_note: Goal diagnosis (draft v0.2). Before making a goal, the coach asks what's wrong and when. skillTypes gives each kind of shot its own problems and 'when' list; problemsByGroup is the fallback (specialist shots, movement, tactics, mentality). Each problem has a kind (technique, decision, position, pressure) for the coach, and a suggested goal the player can edit.
